```{r cifreport-html-body, echo=FALSE, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=5.5}
heading <- function(level, label) {
  cat(sprintf("\n<h%d>%s</h%d>\n\n", level, .cifreport_html(label), level))
}
paragraph <- function(sentences, subgroup) {
  if (!length(sentences)) return(invisible(NULL))
  if (!is.null(subgroup))
    sentences[1L] <- paste0(sub("\\.$", "", sentences[1L]), " (subgroup analysis of ", subgroup, ").")
  cat("<p>", .cifreport_html(paste(sentences, collapse = " ")), "</p>\n\n", sep = "")
}
heading(1, report$specifications$title)
level <- paste0(format(100 * report$specifications$conf.int, trim = TRUE), "%")
table_number <- 0L
figure_number <- 0L
table_heading <- function(label, suffix) {
  table_number <<- table_number + 1L
  cat('\n<div class="cifreport-table-gap" aria-hidden="true"></div>\n\n')
  heading(2, paste0("Table ", table_number, ". ", label, suffix))
  cat('<div class="cifreport-table-gap-after" aria-hidden="true"></div>\n\n')
}
for (population in names(report$tables)) {
  subgroup <- if (population != "All") report$subgroup_titles[[population]]
  suffix <- if (is.null(subgroup)) "" else paste(" in", subgroup)
  for (group in names(report$tables[[population]])) {
    exposure <- report$exposure_titles[[population]][[group]]
    tables <- report$tables[[population]][[group]]
    info <- report$narrative[[population]][[group]]
    table_heading(paste("Description of baseline characteristics according to", exposure), suffix)
    if (is.null(tables$table1)) {
      cat("<p>No results available. See the analysis status log.</p>\n")
    } else {
      cat(.cifreport_baseline_html(tables$table1), "\n\n")
    }
    paragraph(.cifreport_baseline_text(tables$table1, table_number,
      report$specifications$data.name, info), subgroup)
    table_heading(paste("Definition of outcomes and", exposure), suffix)
    .cifreport_print_table(tables$table2, c(outcome_id = "Outcome", time = "Time", event = "Event",
      group_label = "Exposure", primary = "Primary", code.event1 = "Code", competing = "Competing",
      code.event2 = "Code", censored = "Censored", code.censoring = "Code"))
    paragraph(.cifreport_outcome_text(tables$table2, table_number, info$exposure), subgroup)
    if (nrow(tables$table2) && all(vapply(report$fits[[population]][[group]], is.null, logical(1L)))) {
      cat("<p>No events were observed in this subgroup. See the analysis status log.</p>\n")
      next
    }
    table_heading(paste("Description of outcomes at specified time-points according to", exposure), suffix)
    plots <- Filter(Negate(is.null), report$figures[[population]][[group]])
    figures <- figure_number + seq_along(plots)
    figure_number <- figure_number + length(plots)
    .cifreport_print_table(tables$table3, c(outcome_id = "Outcome", timepoint = "Time",
      group_label = "Exposure", primary = "Primary events", competing = "Competing events",
      estimate = "Estimate", conf.low = paste(level, "CI lower"),
      conf.high = paste(level, "CI upper"), estimator = "Estimator"))
    paragraph(.cifreport_time_text(tables$table3, table_number, level, info$followup, figures), subgroup)
    table_heading(paste("Crude risk ratios for the primary and competing events and", exposure,
                        "at specified time-points"), suffix)
    .cifreport_print_table(tables$table4, c(outcome_id = "Outcome", timepoint = "Time",
      event_type = "Event", comparison_label = "Comparison", reference_label = "Reference",
      estimate = "Risk ratio", conf.low = paste(level, "CI lower"), conf.high = paste(level, "CI upper"),
      p.value = "p-value"))
    paragraph(.cifreport_ratio_text(tables$table4, table_number, level, info$reference), subgroup)
    table_heading(paste("Results of tests for the primary event and", exposure), suffix)
    .cifreport_print_table(tables$table5, c(outcome_id = "Outcome", method = "Test",
      statistic = "Chi-square", parameter = "Degrees of freedom", p.value = "p-value"))
    paragraph(.cifreport_test_text(tables$table5, table_number), subgroup)
    if (!length(plots)) cat("<p>No plots available. See the analysis status log.</p>\n")
    for (i in seq_along(plots)) {
      heading(2, paste0("Figure ", figures[i], ". ", names(plots)[i], " according to ", exposure, suffix))
      print(plots[[i]])
      cat("\n\n")
    }
  }
}
heading(2, "Analysis status log")
if (nrow(report$status)) {
  .cifreport_print_table(report$status, c(population_id = "Population", group_id = "Grouping",
    outcome_id = "Outcome", timepoint = "Time", group_level = "Group", analysis = "Analysis",
    status = "Status", message = "Reason"))
} else {
  cat("<p>All requested analyses completed.</p>\n")
}
heading(2, "Software versions")
cat("<p>", .cifreport_html(paste(names(report$versions[!is.na(report$versions)]),
  report$versions[!is.na(report$versions)], collapse = ", ")), "</p>")
```
